founded_year.notes: Upstage’s About page explicitly states that it was founded in 2020: https://www.upstage.ai/about.

eng_blog.notes: Two posts describe implementation rather than just product benefits: WriteUp covers Solar quantization and engine optimization, while the table-recognition post explains TFLOP’s pointer-based OCR mapping. Their coauthors include Junyeop Lee and Teakgyu Hong, respectively, whose profiles identify engineering roles at Upstage. Sources: https://upstage.ai/blog/en/on-device-writeup; https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/ai-powered-table-recognition-just-got-smarter; https://linkedin.com/in/leejunyeop; https://linkedin.com/in/tghong.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation links to separate Generate, Parse and Extract articles, plus guides such as rate limits and token counting: https://developers.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Upstage has a live AI Engineer – LLM Serving Platform posting with an application link: https://careers.upstage.ai/en/o/215818.
